metadata.title: Benchmark Radar v0.9.0: Technical Report
metadata.description: Benchmark Radar v0.9.0 collects new AI benchmark papers, repositories, datasets, and model reports from 37 public sources. This report follows the pipeline from collection through catalog search, model-card adoption, and score history. At the 29 August 2026 cutoff, the cumulative corpus holds 7,540 source observations for 4,537 artifacts across 37 snapshots. Web search covers 1,242 entries: 1,173 external catalog records and 69 curated score tracks. The software uses the MIT License. The technical report and original editorial content use CC BY-NC 4.0. Commercial republication, resale, paid newsletters, dataset packaging, or commercial product integration requires prior written permission from Koutian Wu. Third-party source material remains under its original terms.
